title: NEW: verify_application_in_vacancy DB Error collapses into the catch-all 404 — the same catch-all class N10 fixed one query down
detail: r4 N10 gave verify_vacancy_active an explicit Error arm, but the app↔vacancy precheck one level up still swallows Error into the `_` arm: a transient DB failure 404s as "Application not found". Fail-closed (action never runs), so no N10-style hazard — just a misdiagnosed error.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit `Error(err)` arm for verify_application_in_vacancy that logs and returns the branded 500 (db_failure), keeping the `_` arm for the 0-row not-found case only.
